name: brand-amplification
description: Brand Amplification Engine (xOS) v0.59.0 - The outbound brand-building engine for xOS. Coordinated content distribution across owned surfaces (LinkedIn, Substack, Reddit, X, Instagram, Facebook, Threads) with hub-and-spoke flywheel, surface coverage matrix, pre-publish quality gates, offline Reddit pre-post viability checks, relevance-gated campaign strategy, quote-a-day draft flywheel with DRAFT-safe daily cadence, draft-first screenshot cascade planning, and confidence-ladder browser defaults (browserbase for setup; chrome-devtools-mcp for posting per Irreversible-Action Invariant). Graduates workflow-by-workflow to browserbase after ~10 successful runs. Brain-kernel integrated for primitive writes (identity/handles.md), local telemetry writes, and cross-engine reads. Future sibling engine: Relationship Intelligence Engine (RIE, inbound warm-network detection).
